question: The Seventh Five Year Plan was for which of the following time periods?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1985-1990**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Seventh Five Year Plan in India was from 1985 to 1990**
 
• The **plan's main objectives included: **
 
 
• Increasing agricultural production
 
• Increasing economic productivity
 
• Generating employment
 
• Establishing a self-sufficient economy
 
• Introducing the Min Needs Program for the poor
 
• Improving the transport and communication system
 
• Increasing government investments in healthcare
 
 
 
• The** plan was implemented under the rule of Prime Minister Rajiv Gandhi.**
 
• India's **growth rate during this period was 6%, which was higher than the targeted 5%. **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The first five-year plan in India was launched in 1951 and since then, India has witnessed twelve Five Year Plans.
 
• The present government had however discontinued the Five-year plan system and a new mechanism was put into place.
 
• The decades-old Five-Year Plans was replaced by a three-year action plan, which will be part of a seven-year strategy paper and a 15-year vision document.
 
• The Niti Aayog has replaced the Planning Commission in the Modi Cabinet and launched three-year action plans from April 1, 2017, onwards.
